representation.encoder: MLP 768-256-128 GELU with linear four-class head
representation.selection_metric: mean subject balanced accuracy on task_head_validation context runs

block_discovery.method: eigendecomposition of symmetrized cross-run subject-centroid covariance after discovery-run mean centering

controls.construction: same-rank Haar subspace; per-sample intervention displacement norm exactly matched to candidate block

inference.permutation: subject-level sign flip; exact when feasible
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction separately across four blocks for H1, H2, H3-finite, and H4

gates.H1: Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05 and LCB95 of candidate-minus-matched-random same-subject cross-run distance advantage >0
gates.H3: LCB95(local candidate/random)>1 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05 AND LCB95(finite candidate/random)>1
gates.H4: Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05, LCB95(delta_BA_specific)>0, and mean delta_BA_specific>=0.005
gates.H5: all leave-one-subject-out means >0, all leave-one-future-run-out means >0, and >=60% subjects have nonnegative delta_BA_specific
gates.actionable_harmful: H1 AND H2 AND H3 AND H4 AND H5

agdi_authorization: at least one real block passes H1-H5
